exposure: Planned VBAC without labor induction vs. ERCS
Planned mode of birth after previous caesarean section
planned vaginal birth after previous caesarean (VBAC)
Planned VBAC with labor induction vs. ERCS
cohort: 44,892 singleton children born at term in Scotland between 2002 and 2011 to women with one or more previous caesarean sections
finding: Children born following planned VBAC compared with ERCS had a similar risk of having a record of any SENs.
mod_finding: An increased risk of sensory impairment was seen for planned VBAC with labor induction compared with ERCS.
